_comment: Plan 754.2 (2026-08-04). The `hive` server is deliberately ABSENT: it now comes from the installed plugin hive-channel@wonderforge instead. Two servers both named `hive` collide, the plugin's copy loses, and you get the worst failure shape available — tools keep working so the agent looks healthy, while the channel never arms and no event ever arrives. The plugin must be the sole definition. ROLLBACK: restore the block below into mcpServers and revert claudeArgs in virtual-launcher/configs/spark.json to ["--dangerously-load-development-channels", "server:hive", "-n", "Spark"].
